name: Tick! Tack!
source:
The four friends, Rin, Nerine, Mayumi, and Itsuki, decided to have a sleepover at Nerine's house. After Mayumi accidentally activated a magical artifact, however, they found themselves in the middle of a forest. After walking for a while, they found Nerine's parents' house. The four thought they could return home safely, but what appeared in front of them was a younger Sage and Forbesii's fiance, Ai. Then they realized they had been transported to the demon world 20 years in the past.

Thanks to the younger Forbesii, who still live in the Demon Palace, they were allowed to stay until they found the magic artifact to return to their original timeline.

It is also the day Sage, Nerine's mother, will confess her feelings to Forbesii. However, the confession day has been moved since history has been disrupted by the unexpected appearance of the four.

Will they be able to return to the present day without altering the course of history? 

[Translated and edited from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tick!_Tack!]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
四位好友——凛、奈留奈、真弓和树决定在奈留奈家过夜。然而在真弓意外启动了一件魔法道具后，他们发现自己身处森林之中。走了一阵后，他们找到了奈留奈父母的家。四人以为可以安全回家了，但出现在他们面前的是更年轻的赛奇和佛贝西的未婚妻爱。然后他们意识到，自己被传送到了20年前的魔界。

多亏了还住在魔宫里的年轻佛贝西，他们被允许留下，直到找到返回原来时间线的魔法道具。

这一天也是奈留奈的母亲赛奇向佛贝西表白的日子。然而，由于四人的意外出现扰乱了历史，表白的日子被推迟了。

他们能否在不改变历史进程的情况下回到现在？

[译编自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tick!_Tack!]Wikipedia[/url]]
